items.title: MIT 5.61 Physical Chemistry, Fall 2017

note.zh: 量子化学导论课程：波与粒子、波动力学、矩阵力学、微扰理论、分子轨道理论、分子结构与光化学。
note.en: Introduction to quantum chemistry: particles and waves, wave mechanics, matrix mechanics, perturbation theory, molecular orbital theory, molecular structure and photochemistry.

items.title: 【量子化学 5.61 2014】麻省理工学院—中英字幕

note.zh: 麻省理工量子化学课的中英字幕版，从量子力学的历史背景、光电效应和双缝实验讲到势箱与谐振子等模型体系。
note.en: MIT quantum chemistry lectures with Chinese-English subtitles, from the historical background of quantum mechanics, the photoelectric effect and the two-slit experiment to model systems such as the particle in a box and the harmonic oscillator.

items.title: MIT 8.04 Quantum Physics I, Spring 2013 (2013)

note.zh: 量子物理的第一门课：量子物理的实验基础、波动力学，以及一维和三维的薛定谔方程。
note.en: First course in quantum physics: its experimental basis, wave mechanics, and the Schrödinger equation in one and three dimensions.

items.title: Chemistry - Introductory Quantum Chemistry

note.zh: 印度科学学院无机与物理化学系开设的量子化学入门课程，适合初次系统学习量子化学的读者。
note.en: Introductory quantum chemistry course from the Department of Inorganic and Physical Chemistry at the Indian Institute of Science, Bangalore, for readers meeting the subject for the first time.

items.title: September 2020 - Quantum Chemistry of Atoms and Molecules

note.zh: 印度理工学院孟买分校开设的 NPTEL 课程，按周系统讲授原子与分子的量子化学。
note.en: An NPTEL course from IIT Bombay that teaches the quantum chemistry of atoms and molecules week by week.

items.title: Quantum Chemistry and Spectroscopy

note.zh: 按本科物理化学课程编排的短讲：为何需要量子理论、经典波动方程、量子力学原理、势箱、谐振子、刚性转子、氢原子，直到光谱。
note.en: Short lectures following an undergraduate physical chemistry course: why quantum theory is needed, the classical wave equation, the principles of quantum mechanics, particle in a box, harmonic oscillator, rigid rotor, hydrogen atom and spectroscopy.

items.title: Physical Chemistry II - Quantum Mechanics and Spectroscopy

note.zh: 物理化学 II 的短讲课程，从量子力学导论和经典力学的失效讲起，涵盖量子力学与光谱。
note.en: Short lectures for a second physical chemistry course, starting from an introduction to quantum mechanics and the failure of classical mechanics, and covering quantum mechanics and spectroscopy.

items.title: Core - Quantum Physics

note.zh: 印度理工学院马德拉斯分校物理系的量子物理系列讲座，适合想打牢量子力学物理基础的读者。
note.en: Quantum physics lecture series from the IIT Madras physics department, for readers who want a firmer physics foundation in quantum mechanics.

items.title: 量子力学（修订版）

note.zh: 大学量子力学课程录像，从经典理论的困难、黑体辐射和玻尔理论讲到物质波与量子力学的几种等价表述。
note.en: Recorded university quantum mechanics course, from the difficulties of classical theory, blackbody radiation and Bohr theory to matter waves and equivalent formulations of quantum mechanics.

items.title: 手把手教你量子力学

note.zh: 面向物理系学生的量子力学系列，从黑体辐射、波粒二象性讲到薛定谔方程与统计诠释，重视概念理解。
note.en: Quantum mechanics series aimed at physics students, from blackbody radiation and wave–particle duality to the Schrödinger equation and Born's interpretation, with emphasis on conceptual understanding.

items.title: 量子化学入门【已完结】

note.zh: 作者自制的量子化学入门系列，从量子力学基本假设、无限深势阱和三维势箱讲到氢原子。
note.en: An introductory quantum chemistry series made by its author, from the postulates of quantum mechanics, the infinite square well and the 3D box to the hydrogen atom.

items.title: 量子化学基础

note.zh: 以 Levine《Quantum Chemistry》第 7 版为教材的量子化学讲解，从测不准原理、薛定谔方程讲到一维势箱和方势阱。
note.en: Quantum chemistry lectures following Levine's Quantum Chemistry (7th edition), from the uncertainty principle and the Schrödinger equation to the particle in a box and square wells.

items.title: Introduction to Computational Chemistry

note.zh: 面向计算化学初学者的系列讲座，从分子力学的伸缩、弯曲、扭转项和非键项讲起。
note.en: Lecture series for beginning computational chemists, starting from molecular mechanics: stretch, bend and torsion terms and nonbonded terms.

items.title: ComputationalChemistryUMN

note.zh: 明尼苏达大学计算化学课的全部录像，面向高年级本科生和一年级研究生，涵盖势能面与力场、后 HF 方法、溶剂化模型和激发态，附 PDF 讲义。
note.en: All lecture videos of the University of Minnesota computational chemistry course for seniors and first-year graduate students, covering potential energy surfaces and force fields, post-Hartree–Fock methods, solvation models and excited states, with PDF slides.

items.title: Jan 2025 - Computational Quantum Chemistry

note.zh: 印度理工学院孟买分校的计算量子化学课，讲 Hartree-Fock、基组、电子相关、耦合簇与 CASSCF，并用 ORCA 演示计算。
note.en: Computational quantum chemistry course from IIT Bombay covering Hartree–Fock, basis sets, electron correlation, coupled cluster and CASSCF, with calculations in ORCA.

items.title: Jan 2024 - Many body methods in quantum chemistry

note.zh: 印度理工学院孟买分校的量子化学多体方法课程，从经典力学的失效讲起，直到基组与耦合簇理论。
note.en: IIT Bombay NPTEL course on many-body methods in quantum chemistry, from the failure of classical mechanics to basis sets and coupled-cluster theory.

items.title: Computational Chemistry

note.zh: 电子相关方法的系列短讲：Slater-Condon 规则、Hartree-Fock 的解离问题、Møller-Plesset 微扰和耦合簇理论，带推导。
note.en: Short lectures on electron-correlation methods: Slater–Condon rules, the Hartree–Fock dissociation problem, Møller–Plesset perturbation theory and coupled-cluster theory, with derivations.

items.title: Density Functional Theory

note.zh: 研究生密度泛函理论课程，从基本定理讲到现代方法，课程网站提供讲义与测验。
note.en: Graduate course on density functional theory, from the fundamental theorems to modern techniques; slides and quizzes are on the course website.

items.title: Intro to DFT - Day 1: Density-functional theory - Nicola Marzari

note.zh: 电子结构方法与密度泛函理论的入门讲座，面向想学 DFT 的各类读者。
note.en: Introductory lecture on electronic-structure methods and density functional theory, for anyone who wants to learn DFT.

items.title: Hartree-Fock and post-Hartree-Fock methods: Computational aspects (P.-F. Loos)

note.zh: 在线课程中的一讲，讲解 Hartree-Fock 与后 HF 方法在数值计算和程序实现上的要点。
note.en: A lecture from an online course on the numerical and computational aspects of Hartree–Fock and post-Hartree–Fock methods.

items.title: [自制课程] 密度泛函理论（DFT）速训班

note.zh: 课题组内部的 DFT 培训课：预备知识、DFT 理论基础、Wannier 函数、DFT+U 和算法实现，也讲团队编程与 Git。
note.en: Research-group DFT training: prerequisites, DFT foundations, Wannier functions, DFT+U and algorithm implementation, plus team programming and Git.

items.title: 耦合簇理论专题：从入门到入土【已完结】

note.zh: 耦合簇方法专题：从形式理论推导 CCSD 能量与振幅方程，讲费曼图和尺寸一致性，并简介 CCSD(T) 与 EOM-CC。
note.en: Coupled-cluster tutorial: formal theory, derivation of the CCSD energy and amplitude equations, diagrams and size consistency, with brief introductions to CCSD(T) and EOM-CC.

items.title: 【量子化学-学习分享】Hartree-Fock 理论 Part 2：Hartree-Fock 方程的推导

note.zh: 一步步推导 Hartree-Fock 方程，适合学过量子化学基础、想弄清 HF 来龙去脉的读者。
note.en: Step-by-step derivation of the Hartree–Fock equations, for readers who know basic quantum chemistry and want to understand where HF comes from.

items.title: [结构化学]Hartree-Fock，密度泛函和基组：当我们说起计算化学时我们在说什么

note.zh: 从结构化学的角度串讲 Hartree-Fock、密度泛函与基组这几个计算化学的核心概念。
note.en: Connects Hartree–Fock, density functional theory and basis sets, the core concepts of computational chemistry, from a structural-chemistry viewpoint.

items.title: 01 | 一个 H2，讲清第一性原理计算：Hartree-Fock、FCI 与 DFT

note.zh: 以 H2 分子为例讲第一性原理计算的逻辑：BO 近似、势能曲线，以及 Hartree-Fock、全组态相互作用与 DFT 各自的假设。
note.en: Uses the H2 molecule to explain the logic of first-principles calculations: the Born–Oppenheimer approximation, potential-energy curves, and the assumptions behind Hartree–Fock, full CI and DFT.

items.title: 从Hartree–Fock到全CI：组态相互作用怎么算，又为什么这么难？

note.zh: 从氢分子键拉长时 HF 失效出发讲组态相互作用：推导 Hc = Ec，讨论全 CI 的瓶颈和选择性 CI 等改进。
note.en: Starts from the failure of Hartree–Fock when the H2 bond is stretched to explain configuration interaction: deriving Hc = Ec, the bottlenecks of full CI, and remedies such as selected CI.

items.title: GaussView 6 Fundamentals

note.zh: Gaussian 官方的 GaussView 6 基础课，讲选取分子、设置 Gaussian 计算等基本操作。
note.en: Official short course on GaussView 6 basics, such as selecting molecules and setting up Gaussian calculations.

items.title: VWSCC25 - A Quick Introduction to Using ORCA

note.zh: ORCA 开发方在计算化学虚拟冬季学校上的入门报告，介绍怎样开始用 ORCA 做计算。
note.en: Introductory talk by the ORCA developers at the Virtual Winter School on Computational Chemistry on getting started with ORCA calculations.

items.title: Week 1: Lecture 4: Introduction to ORCA, Quantum Chemistry Package

note.zh: NPTEL 课程第一周的一讲，向初学者介绍量子化学程序包 ORCA。
note.en: Week-1 lecture of an NPTEL course introducing the ORCA quantum-chemistry package to newcomers.

items.title: Computational Chemistry: Avogadro+ORCA Tutorial

note.zh: 印度一所学院化学系计算化学短期课程的上机模块，演示用 Avogadro 建模、用 ORCA 做量子化学计算。
note.en: Lab modules from a short computational-chemistry course by a college chemistry department in India, showing how to build molecules in Avogadro and run quantum-chemistry calculations in ORCA.

items.title: Psi4 for beginners

note.zh: Psi4 开发团队的入门教程，演示怎样用 Psi4 运行基本的量子化学计算。
note.en: Beginner tutorial from the Psi4 developers showing how to run basic quantum-chemistry computations in Psi4.

items.title: PySCF: The Python Based Simulations of Chemistry Framework- Qiming Sun | SciPy 2022

note.zh: SciPy 2022 会议报告，介绍并演示用 Python 包 PySCF 做量子化学模拟。
note.en: SciPy 2022 talk introducing and demonstrating quantum-chemistry simulations with the Python package PySCF.

items.title: TURBOMOLE Tutorials for Beginners

note.zh: TURBOMOLE 开发者之一制作的上手系列，逐步演示各类量子化学计算，可配合官方手册使用。
note.en: Step-by-step walkthroughs of different quantum-chemistry calculations in TURBOMOLE by one of its developers, meant to complement the manual.

items.title: How to CASSCF, tutorial with ORCA

note.zh: 以高自旋 Co(II) 配合物为例，演示在 ORCA 中设置和提交 CASSCF 计算并讲解注意事项。
note.en: Uses a high-spin Co(II) complex to show how to set up and submit a CASSCF calculation in ORCA, with practical remarks.

items.title: Gaussian入门教程

note.zh: Gaussian 软件的入门系列教程，适合第一次使用 Gaussian 做量子化学计算的学生。
note.en: Introductory series on the Gaussian program for students running quantum-chemistry calculations for the first time.

items.title: Gaussian简短入门

note.zh: Gaussian 快速入门：GaussView 建模与提交、基组与单点能、结构优化、频率与热化学、过渡态与 IRC、NMR 和势能面扫描。
note.en: Quick Gaussian course: GaussView and job submission, basis sets and single points, optimization, frequencies and thermochemistry, transition states and IRC, NMR and scans.

items.title: 001 ORCA：输入文件的生成、计算、分析——以分子轨道和能量信息为例

note.zh: 以分子轨道和能量为例，演示 ORCA 输入文件的生成、计算和结果分析，并在 Avogadro 中查看轨道。
note.en: Uses molecular orbitals and energies as the example to show how to generate ORCA inputs, run the job and analyse results, viewing orbitals in Avogadro.

items.title: 量子化学入门 - 计算部分【更新至8P】

note.zh: 量子化学入门课的配套上机，用 PySCF 和 ORCA 做 HF、弥散基组和 CCSD(T) 原子化能等基础计算。
note.en: Hands-on companion to an introductory quantum-chemistry course: basic PySCF and ORCA calculations such as HF, diffuse basis sets and CCSD(T) atomization energies.

items.title: 使用xtb软件扫描势能面获取反应过渡态初猜

note.zh: 用 xtb 扫描势能面得到过渡态初猜，再用 ORCA 做 DFT 过渡态验证的完整流程。
note.en: Full workflow for scanning a potential energy surface with xtb to get a transition-state guess, then confirming it with a DFT transition-state search in ORCA.

items.title: Getting started with VASP

note.zh: VASP 官方为新用户选编的讲座：第一次从头算、电子步与结构优化、声子、分子动力学、对称性、杂化泛函、高性能计算和线性响应。
note.en: The VASP developers' selection for new users: a first ab-initio calculation, electronic and structure optimization, phonons, molecular dynamics, symmetry, hybrid functionals, HPC and linear response.

items.title: MaX School on QE: Quantum ESPRESSO overview and basic functionalities - GEBAUER

note.zh: MaX 举办的 Quantum ESPRESSO 学校中的讲座，概述 QE 及其基本功能，适合刚开始用 QE 的研究者。
note.en: Lecture from the MaX school on Quantum ESPRESSO giving an overview of the code and its basic functionalities, for researchers starting with QE.

items.title: Projects: Quantum Espresso Tutorial 2019

note.zh: 按小项目练习 Quantum ESPRESSO：从下载 SSSP 赝势，到分子、硅晶体、声子色散和玻恩-奥本海默分子动力学。
note.en: Project-based Quantum ESPRESSO practice, from downloading SSSP pseudopotentials to molecules, silicon crystals, phonon dispersion and Born-Oppenheimer molecular dynamics.

items.title: Introduction to CP2K (March 2019)

note.zh: 根特大学三天 CP2K 入门课程的录像：高斯加平面波方法、从头算分子动力学、运行 CP2K 计算，以及 GAPW 方法与电子结构性质等。
note.en: Recorded three-day introductory CP2K course at Ghent University: the Gaussian and plane waves method, ab initio molecular dynamics, running CP2K calculations, and the GAPW method with electronic-structure properties.

items.title: Exciton Science online tutorials

note.zh: 在线教程系列，先讲密度泛函理论能解决哪些问题，再演示用 GPAW 在 Python 里完成基础 DFT 计算。
note.en: Online tutorial series that first explains what density functional theory is for, then shows basic DFT tasks in Python with GPAW.

items.title: FHI-aims tutorial series

note.zh: FHI-aims 官方教程系列，讲电子结构理论入门、数值原子轨道基组及其用法，并配有上机练习。
note.en: Official FHI-aims tutorial series on electronic-structure theory basics and on numeric atom-centred orbitals and how to use them, with hands-on sessions.

items.title: Wannier 2022 Summer School | (smr 3705)
items.channel: ICTP Condensed Matter and Statistical Physics

note.zh: ICTP 的 Wannier 暑期学校：最局域化 Wannier 函数、电极化与量子几何，并有 Wannier90 上机练习。
note.en: ICTP summer school on maximally localized Wannier functions, electric polarization and quantum geometry, with hands-on Wannier90 sessions.

items.title: Advanced Quantum ESPRESSO school 2023

note.zh: 进阶 Quantum ESPRESSO 学校的讲座，专题是用线性响应确定参数的 Hubbard（DFT+U）与 Koopmans 泛函。
note.en: Lectures from an advanced Quantum ESPRESSO school on Hubbard (DFT+U) and Koopmans functionals obtained from linear response.

items.title: 不讲原理，直接上手：VASP能带计算速成

note.zh: 略过原理，直接演示用 VASP 完成能带计算的操作流程，适合想尽快上手的新手。
note.en: Skips the theory and walks through a VASP band-structure calculation step by step, for beginners who want to get started quickly.

items.title: VASP_基础教程 (币留给更需要的人吧，小伙伴们给我点个赞就行，在参加B站的学霸计划，点赞鼓励我做下去）

note.zh: 作者边学边录的 VASP 基础系列：截断能测试、输出文件解读、自旋与磁矩、离子弛豫参数、频率计算和生成输入文件的脚本。
note.en: VASP basics recorded as the author learned them: cutoff tests, reading output files, spin and magnetic moments, ionic relaxation settings, frequency calculations and scripts for input files.

items.title: 应用 Materials Studio 的 CASTEP 模块计算能带和态密度

note.zh: 武汉理工大学教师录制的 Materials Studio 入门课，演示用 CASTEP 模块计算能带和态密度。
note.en: Introductory Materials Studio lesson recorded by a Wuhan University of Technology lecturer, computing band structures and densities of states with CASTEP.

items.title: 培训视频 | CP2K实践

note.zh: 厦门大学课题组的 CP2K 培训：单点能、结构优化、NEB 过渡态搜索、频率计算和分子动力学。
note.en: CP2K training from a Xiamen University group: single points, geometry optimization, NEB transition-state searches, frequency calculations and molecular dynamics.

items.title: 培训视频 | Quantum EspressO/VASP实战

note.zh: 厦门大学课题组的 QE 与 VASP 实战培训：输入输出参数、任务提交与监控、结构优化、自洽与能带计算及可视化。
note.en: Hands-on Quantum ESPRESSO and VASP training from a Xiamen University group: input and output settings, job submission and monitoring, relaxation, SCF and band calculations, visualization.

items.title: 材料模拟计算入门讲义 9.能带计算

note.zh: 计算材料学入门讲义的能带一讲：k 点路径、计算设置、数据处理，以及从能带读出带隙、有效质量等信息。
note.en: Band-structure lesson from an introductory computational-materials series: k-point paths, calculation settings, data processing, and reading gaps and effective masses from the bands.

items.title: Molecular Biophysics - all lectures as concepts

note.zh: 分子生物物理整门课按概念切成的短讲合集，按顺序排列，涉及 Helmholtz 与 Gibbs 自由能、模拟系综、炼金术结合自由能计算和同源建模等。
note.en: An entire molecular biophysics course cut into short concept videos in order, covering Helmholtz and Gibbs free energy, simulation ensembles, alchemical binding free-energy calculations and homology modelling, among others.

items.title: Computational Chemistry and Classical Molecular Dynamics

note.zh: 印度理工学院孟买分校的 NPTEL 课程，按周讲授计算化学与经典分子动力学，适合系统学习分子模拟。
note.en: NPTEL course from IIT Bombay, taught week by week, on computational chemistry and classical molecular dynamics, for a systematic grounding in molecular simulation.

items.title: 25. Statistical Foundation for Molecular Dynamics Simulation

note.zh: MIT 纳微尺度传输课程中的一讲，讲分子动力学模拟所依据的统计力学基础，适合动手模拟前补理论。
note.en: A lecture from an MIT transport course on the statistical-mechanics foundations behind molecular dynamics simulation; useful theory before running simulations.

items.title: Fundamental concepts of relative binding Free Energy Perturbation (FEP) calculations

note.zh: 解释相对结合自由能微扰（FEP）计算中的基本概念与术语，适合刚接触 FEP 的药物设计研究者。
note.en: Explains the basic concepts and terms of relative binding free-energy perturbation (FEP) calculations, for drug-design researchers new to FEP.

items.title: Free Energy Workshop 2023

note.zh: 自由能计算研讨会的报告录像，讨论自由能估计方法、绝对结合自由能等进展，适合做结合亲和力预测的研究者。
note.en: Talks from a free-energy workshop on how to estimate free energies, absolute binding free energies and related advances, for researchers predicting binding affinities.

items.title: PLUMED Masterclass 21

note.zh: PLUMED 官方大师课系列，讲用 PLUMED 定义集合变量、分析轨迹并做增强采样，适合已会跑 MD 的研究者。
note.en: Official PLUMED masterclass series on defining collective variables, analysing trajectories and running enhanced sampling with PLUMED, for researchers who already run MD.

items.title: Bioexcel webinar #87: The GROMACS tutorial suite: from basic to advanced applications

note.zh: BioExcel 网络研讨会，介绍 tutorials.gromacs.org 上从基础到进阶的 GROMACS 教程套件及其涵盖的方法。
note.en: BioExcel webinar introducing the GROMACS tutorial suite at tutorials.gromacs.org and the methods it covers, from basic to advanced applications.

items.title: LAMMPS Tutorial 2024

note.zh: LAMMPS 研讨会配套的教程直播录像，带新用户上手 LAMMPS 分子动力学模拟，并现场回答观众提问。
note.en: Live-streamed tutorial session of a LAMMPS workshop that walks new users through molecular dynamics with LAMMPS and answers audience questions.

items.title: 分子动力学模拟-第1讲-牛顿力学基础（樊哲勇）

note.zh: 研究生课程，从牛顿力学讲起，涵盖分子动力学理论基础、实用算法、C++ 与 Python 编程实现和 GPUMD 用例。
note.en: Graduate molecular dynamics course starting from Newtonian mechanics: theory, practical algorithms, C++ and Python implementations, and GPUMD use cases.

items.title: 分子动力学基础

note.zh: 从原理讲分子动力学到底怎样计算，边讲边写程序，涉及弛豫、元胞方法和邻接表，适合想弄懂算法的学生。
note.en: Explains how molecular dynamics is actually computed while writing the programs step by step: relaxation, cell methods and neighbour lists; for students who want to understand the algorithms.

items.title: 傻瓜式保姆级速通分子动力学模拟

note.zh: 用 GROMACS 和 ACPYPE 跑通蛋白-配体模拟：环境配置、体系预处理、NVT/NPT 平衡、生产模拟和轨迹可视化。
note.en: Runs a protein–ligand simulation end to end with GROMACS and ACPYPE: environment setup, system preparation, NVT/NPT equilibration, production MD and trajectory visualisation.

items.title: lammps新手入门教程：Cu融化in文件编写

note.zh: 以铜的熔化为例讲解 LAMMPS in 输入文件的编写，适合刚开始用 LAMMPS 做材料模拟的新手。
note.en: Walks through writing a LAMMPS input script for melting copper, for newcomers starting materials simulations with LAMMPS.

items.title: 培训视频 | 自由能计算方法

note.zh: 课题组培训课：从统计角度讲自由能及其与势能面的区别，介绍增强采样方法的原理，并演示一个简单实例。
note.en: Group training lecture: free energy from a statistical viewpoint and how it differs from the potential energy surface, enhanced-sampling principles, and a simple worked example.

items.title: 基于集合变量的增强采样算法 - 付浩浩博士 | 钰沐菡 公益公开

note.zh: 公益讲座：基于集合变量的增强采样理论、在分子动力学软件中的应用，以及蛋白-配体结合自由能的准确计算。
note.en: Free public lecture on collective-variable-based enhanced sampling: theory, use in MD software, and accurate protein–ligand binding free-energy calculations.

items.title: 使用Multiwfn做NCI分析展现分子内和分子间弱相互作用

note.zh: 演示用 Multiwfn 做 NCI（RDG）分析，展示分子内与分子间弱相互作用的区域和类型，并结合 VMD 作图。
note.en: Demonstrates NCI (RDG) analysis in Multiwfn to show where weak intra- and intermolecular interactions occur and what type they are, with figures rendered in VMD.

items.title: 使用Multiwfn和VMD对配合物激发态绘制空穴-电子等值面图

note.zh: 基于 Gaussian 的 TDDFT 输出，用 Multiwfn 对过渡金属配合物做激发态空穴-电子分析，并用 VMD 绘制等值面。
note.en: Uses Gaussian TDDFT output and Multiwfn to run hole–electron analysis of an excited state of a transition-metal complex, rendering the isosurfaces in VMD.

items.title: 零基础使用gaussian对分子轨道绘制及配合Multiwfn和VMD对高质量分子轨道的绘制教程

note.zh: 面向零基础，讲用 Gaussian 结果绘制分子轨道，并配合 Multiwfn 和 VMD 画出高质量的轨道等值面图。
note.en: Beginner walkthrough of plotting molecular orbitals from Gaussian results, then producing high-quality orbital isosurface figures with Multiwfn and VMD.

items.title: Multiwfn+VMD+gunplot进行IGMH分析

note.zh: 演示用 Multiwfn、VMD 和 gnuplot 做 IGMH 分析，直观展现化学体系中的弱相互作用，并给出官方 IGMH 教程文件的链接。
note.en: Shows how to run IGMH analysis with Multiwfn, VMD and gnuplot to visualise weak interactions in chemical systems, with a link to the official IGMH tutorial files.

items.title: Pymol作图入门教程1

note.zh: PyMOL 作图入门，讲如何制作高质量的分子三维结构图，尤其是蛋白质等生物大分子。
note.en: Introduction to making high-quality 3D structure figures in PyMOL, especially of proteins and other biomacromolecules.

items.title: 【科研必备】分子可视化必备工具：VMD软件，从入门到使用

note.zh: 介绍分子动力学可视化软件 VMD 的下载安装、基本操作和动态展示，适合第一次用 VMD 的学生。
note.en: Covers downloading, installing and basic use of VMD, the molecular-dynamics visualisation program, including animated display, for first-time users.

items.title: Noncovalent Interactions (NCI) Tutorials | Gaussian, ORCA, Multiwfn, VMD & Gnuplot

note.zh: 讲非共价相互作用的原理与 NCI 分析实操：用 Gaussian 或 ORCA 计算，再用 Multiwfn、VMD 和 gnuplot 分析作图。
note.en: Theory of noncovalent interactions plus hands-on NCI analysis: calculations in Gaussian or ORCA, then analysis and plotting with Multiwfn, VMD and gnuplot.

items.title: 03.03 Localized Molecular Orbitals and NBO Theory

note.zh: 对比定域与正则分子轨道，讲自然键轨道（NBO）方法的一般流程并给出实例，适合想读懂 NBO 结果的学生。
note.en: Contrasts localized and canonical molecular orbitals and outlines how the natural bond orbital (NBO) method works, with an example; for students learning to read NBO output.

items.title: ELFCAR and Bader Charges Calculation Using VASP (Emil Jaffal)
items.channel: Materials Informatics Tutorials from Oliynyk Lab

note.zh: 用 VASP 计算并可视化电子局域函数（ELF）和 Bader 电荷，得到可用于论文的图，适合做固体计算的研究者。
note.en: Calculating and visualising the electron localization function (ELF) and Bader charges with VASP to produce publication-ready figures, for solid-state researchers.

items.title: Visualizing Science with PyMOL 3

note.zh: PyMOL 开发方在线认证课程的全部教学视频，系统学习用 PyMOL 3 做分子与蛋白结构可视化。
note.en: All lesson videos of Schrödinger's online PyMOL 3 certification course, a structured route to visualising molecules and protein structures.

items.title: Exploring PDB structures with UCSF Chimera

note.zh: RCSB PDB 出品，从基本选择与操作到结构分析和动画制作，学会用 UCSF Chimera 探索 PDB 结构。
note.en: From RCSB PDB: learn UCSF Chimera for exploring PDB structures, from basic selections and actions to structure analysis and animation.

items.title: Molecular visualization with VMD

note.zh: 科研计算机构的网络讲座，概览用 VMD 做分子可视化的基本功能，适合入门。
note.en: Webinar from a research-computing organisation giving an introductory overview of VMD's basic features for molecular visualisation.

items.title: ChimeraX Tutorials

note.zh: 大学实验室制作的 ChimeraX 系列教程，讲安装、界面与工具以及结构比对分析，适合刚开始做结构可视化的学生。
note.en: Series by a university lab on ChimeraX: installation, the interface and tools, and structural analysis and alignment, for newcomers to structure visualisation.

items.title: CompChem.07.06 Excited Electronic States: Conical Intersections and Dynamics

note.zh: 明尼苏达大学计算化学课的一讲，介绍锥形交叉与激发态动力学的基本概念。
note.en: A lecture from the University of Minnesota computational chemistry course introducing the basic ideas of conical intersections and excited-state dynamics.

items.title: basics of TDDFT linear response

note.zh: CECAM 密度泛函理论教学学校的一讲，讲线性响应 TDDFT 的基本框架，适合已了解基态 DFT 的读者。
note.en: A CECAM school lecture on the basic framework of linear-response TDDFT, for readers who already know ground-state DFT.

items.title: Theoretical Spectroscopy Lectures 2024

note.zh: CECAM 理论光谱学校的系列讲座，讲 TDDFT 与多体微扰理论的理论和数值方法，并配合 ABINIT 等程序上机。
note.en: Lecture series from a CECAM school on theoretical spectroscopy, covering the theory and numerics of TDDFT and many-body perturbation theory with hands-on codes such as ABINIT.

items.title: "Optical Spectroscopy" by Prof. Frank Neese

note.zh: 马普化学能量转换研究所光谱学暑期学校的一讲，主题为光学光谱；讲座与计算上机课程配套。
note.en: A lecture on optical spectroscopy from the Max Planck Institute for Chemical Energy Conversion summer school, which pairs lectures with computational practice sessions.

items.title: 2023 VWSCC: Session 09 — Coupled Cluster Methods for Excited States to Model Spectroscopy

note.zh: 计算化学虚拟冬季学校的一讲，讲用运动方程耦合簇（EOM-CC）方法计算激发态并模拟光谱。
note.en: A Virtual Winter School session on equation-of-motion coupled-cluster methods for excited states and their use in modeling spectroscopy.

items.title: Optical excitations and excitons: BSE and TDDFT | VASP Lecture

note.zh: VASP 官方讲座，介绍光学激发与激子，重点讲 Bethe-Salpeter 方程和含时密度泛函理论。
note.en: An official VASP lecture introducing optical excitations and excitons, focusing on the Bethe-Salpeter equation and time-dependent DFT.

items.title: Avogadro with ORCA Tutorial: UV-Vis calculation

note.zh: 用 Avogadro 和 ORCA 计算紫外-可见吸收：建立输入、分析输出，适合第一次做激发态计算的学生。
note.en: Shows how to set up a UV-Vis excited-state calculation with Avogadro and ORCA and how to analyze the output; suited to a first excited-state calculation.

items.title: Modern Computational Photophysics using the SHARC Package: Part 1 Lectured by Dr. Sebastian Mai

note.zh: 讲用 SHARC 程序包做表面跳跃非绝热动力学、研究分子光物理过程的系列报告第一部分。
note.en: Part 1 of a lecture on modern computational photophysics with the SHARC surface-hopping package for non-adiabatic dynamics.

items.title: Webinars on Computational Photochemistry

note.zh: 圣保罗大学化学研究所组织的计算光化学网络研讨会合集，收录 DNA 与黑色素超快激发态动力学等研究报告。
note.en: A collection of computational photochemistry webinars organized at the University of São Paulo, including research talks such as ultrafast excited-state dynamics in DNA and melanin.

items.title: 零基础使用gaussian计算紫外吸收光谱、荧光发射光谱（激发能）、磷光发射光谱（激发能）

note.zh: 从零开始演示用 Gaussian 计算吸收、荧光和磷光对应的激发能，适合刚接触激发态计算的学生。
note.en: A from-scratch walkthrough of computing absorption, fluorescence and phosphorescence excitation energies with Gaussian, for students new to excited-state calculations.

items.title: Gaussian计算化学实验(13)：激发态的计算和分析

note.zh: Gaussian 基础教程系列的一集，演示激发态计算的设置与结果分析，附相关文件下载。
note.en: An episode of a Gaussian basics series demonstrating how to set up excited-state calculations and analyze the results, with the related files available for download.

items.title: Gaussian激发态计算-1

note.zh: 先讲激发态计算的基础知识，再以苯分子为例在 Gaussian 中演示；同系列还有 TDDFT 与 CASSCF 对比和激发态优化。
note.en: Explains the basics of excited-state calculations and demonstrates them on benzene in Gaussian; later parts of the series compare TDDFT with CASSCF and cover excited-state optimization.

items.title: 3.【量化计算教程】ECD/UV计算 ( 电子圆二色谱、紫外吸收光谱 )

note.zh: 讲如何计算电子圆二色谱和紫外吸收谱并与实验谱拟合，用于确证分子的绝对构型。
note.en: Explains how to compute electronic circular dichroism and UV spectra and fit them to experiment to assign absolute configuration.

items.title: TDDFT激发态计算专题

note.zh: 材料模拟软件开发商的 TDDFT 专题培训录像，从原理、实时与线性响应光吸收谱讲到 Ehrenfest 非绝热动力学及应用。
note.en: Recorded training by a materials-simulation software developer, from TDDFT theory and real-time and linear-response absorption spectra to Ehrenfest non-adiabatic dynamics and applications.

items.title: 37.  Potential Energy Surfaces, Transition State Theory and Reaction Mechanism

note.zh: 耶鲁公开课的一讲，以线性三原子体系为例讲势能面，并由此引出过渡态理论和反应机理。
note.en: A Yale open-course lecture that uses a linear triatomic system to build a potential energy surface and leads from it to transition state theory and reaction mechanisms.

items.title: Short Course: ORCA Advanced Topics (Fall 2021)

note.zh: 德州农工大学高性能计算中心的 ORCA 短期课程，讲用量子化学模拟研究反应机理，带上机练习。
note.en: A Texas A&M HPRC short course on using ORCA quantum-chemistry simulations to study reaction mechanisms, with hands-on exercises.

items.title: Finding Transition States in ORCA (Part I)

note.zh: 先解释什么是过渡态，再演示用 ORCA 的 ScanTS 功能寻找过渡态。
note.en: Explains what a transition state is and shows how to locate one with the ScanTS feature in ORCA.

items.title: Nudged Elastic Band (NEB) Tutorial with Orca

note.zh: 演示在 ORCA 中做微动弹性带（NEB）计算，求反应的最低能量路径。
note.en: Demonstrates a nudged elastic band calculation in ORCA to obtain the minimum energy path of a reaction.

items.title: Example of Thermochemistry Calculation in Gaussian 09

note.zh: 以萘和薁为例，演示一次完整的 Gaussian 09 热化学计算。
note.en: Uses naphthalene and azulene as a worked example of a thermochemistry calculation in Gaussian 09.

items.title: Tutorial 08 | Describing Chemical Reactions With Gaussian | Dr M A Hashmi

note.zh: Gaussian 教程系列的一集，讲如何用计算结果分析和描述一个化学反应。
note.en: An episode of a Gaussian tutorial series on how to analyze and describe a chemical reaction from calculations.

items.title: NANO266 Lecture 11 - Modeling Transition States

note.zh: 课程 NANO266 的一讲，讲如何用微动弹性带（NEB）方法为过渡态建模。
note.en: A lecture from the NANO266 course on modeling transition states with the nudged elastic band method.

items.title: DAY 1 "Estimation of kinetic parameters and microkinetic modeling"

note.zh: 米兰理工大学等主办的多尺度动力学建模研讨会第一天，讲动力学参数估算和微观动力学建模。
note.en: Day 1 of a multiscale kinetic modeling workshop organized by Politecnico di Milano and partners, on estimating kinetic parameters and microkinetic modeling.

items.title: 5.6 Marcus Theory I

note.zh: 分子光化学课程中讲电子转移 Marcus 理论的一节，配有公开的 PDF 讲义。
note.en: A section of a molecular photochemistry course on the Marcus theory of electron transfer, with the slides available as PDFs.

items.title: Gaussian教程系列（9）：IRC的计算，反应路径

note.zh: 讲 Gaussian 中 IRC 的计算与查看，用于可视化反应路径、研究路径上性质和电子结构的变化。
note.en: Shows how to run and inspect an IRC calculation in Gaussian to visualize a reaction path and follow property and electronic-structure changes along it.

items.title: 零基础使用gaussian配合Shermo高精度计算热力学数值教程

note.zh: 面向零基础，演示用 Gaussian 的计算结果配合 Shermo 程序更准确地得到热力学量。
note.en: Beginner walkthrough of combining Gaussian output with the Shermo program to compute thermochemical quantities more accurately.

items.title: VASP+NEB计算化学反应势垒

note.zh: 介绍用 VASP 加 VTST 插件的 NEB 方法计算化学反应势垒。
note.en: Introduces computing reaction barriers with the NEB method in VASP using the VTST add-on.

items.title: 应用 Materials Studio 的 DMol3 模块优化过渡态结构

note.zh: 武汉理工大学教师录制的 Materials Studio 入门教程，分四段讲用 DMol3 模块优化过渡态结构。
note.en: A beginner Materials Studio tutorial recorded by a Wuhan University of Technology lecturer, in four parts on optimizing transition states with the DMol3 module.

items.title: orca量子化学计算301-304:过渡态搜索,过渡态构象搜索,内禀反应坐标,精确计算能垒

note.zh: 翻译 ORCA 教程并实操演示，依次讲过渡态搜索、过渡态构象搜索、IRC 和能垒精确计算。
note.en: A translated and demonstrated walkthrough of ORCA tutorials on transition-state searches, TS conformer searches, IRC and accurate barrier heights.

items.title: ML Meets Molecular Dynamics: A Crash Course in ML Interatomic Potentials

note.zh: 先介绍分子动力学模拟，再讲原子间势的演变和机器学习原子间势，适合初次接触机器学习势的读者。
note.en: Introduces molecular dynamics simulation, then follows how interatomic potentials evolved into machine-learned ones; a starting point for newcomers to ML potentials.

items.title: Crash Course: Applied Machine Learning for Chemistry

note.zh: 面向化学专业学生的三小时机器学习速成课，只讲必要概念，帮助建立直观理解。
note.en: A three-hour crash course that gives chemistry students an intuitive feel for machine learning, sticking to the essential concepts.

items.title: Generative AI for Molecular Design & Synthesis

note.zh: 简要讲解计算与生成式 AI 怎样帮助化学家在庞大的化学空间中设计分子、规划合成。
note.en: A short overview of how computation and generative AI help chemists navigate a vast chemical space to design molecules and plan their synthesis.

items.title: Basics of machine learning force fields | VASP Lecture

note.zh: VASP 官方讲座：为什么以及如何在 VASP 中用机器学习在线训练力场，并有应用示例。
note.en: Official VASP lecture on why and how to train machine-learning force fields on the fly in VASP, with example applications.

items.title: Daniel Schwalbe Koda: Machine learning for interatomic potentials

note.zh: IKZ–FAIRmat 冬季学校的讲座，讲解如何用机器学习构建原子间势，适合有模拟基础的研究生。
note.en: A lecture from the IKZ–FAIRmat winter school on building interatomic potentials with machine learning, for graduate students with some simulation background.

items.title: Applied AI for Materials Science - Winter '21

note.en: Recorded lectures of a University of Chicago course on applied AI for materials science, from training models that predict material properties to natural language processing.

items.title: 9th iCoMSE School: Machine Learning for Molecules (2025)

note.zh: i-CoMSE 线上学校“分子机器学习”的课程录像，概览机器学习在分子研究中的应用，适合研究生入门。
note.en: Recordings from the i-CoMSE virtual school on machine learning for molecules, giving graduate students an overview of how ML is applied to molecular problems.

items.title: Ilyes Batatia - Tutorial: How to Train and Use MACE Interatomic Potentials (Part 1) - GPMLFF 2026
items.channel: General-Purpose MLFFs in Theory and Practice

note.zh: GPMLFF 2026 基础日的教程第一部分，讲怎样训练和使用 MACE 机器学习原子间势。
note.en: Part 1 of a tutorial from the foundations day of GPMLFF 2026 on how to train and use MACE machine-learning interatomic potentials.

items.title: Universal Models for Atoms (UMA) Tutorial

note.zh: 演示通用原子模型 UMA 的使用方法，并附 OMol25 论文等链接，适合想上手预训练势的读者。
note.en: A walkthrough of using the Universal Models for Atoms (UMA), with links to the OMol25 paper; for readers getting started with pretrained potentials.

items.title: 2022 CSI Workshop: Deep Modeling for Molecular Simulation

note.zh: 深度势能方法研讨班：讲座涵盖方法原理、大规模模拟、输运和长程静电，另有 Wannier 中心与 DPLR 上机课。
note.en: Workshop on Deep Potential methods: lectures on the method, large-scale use, transport and long-range electrostatics, plus hands-on sessions on Wannier centers, dipoles and DPLR.

items.title: 张与之：DeePMD原理介绍与上机实践

note.zh: 介绍深度势能（DeePMD）的基本原理与应用场景，并在 Bohrium 云平台上带领完成上机实践。
note.en: Introduces the principles and use cases of Deep Potential (DeePMD), followed by a hands-on session on the Bohrium cloud platform.

items.title: 如何快速训练一个机器学习力场？以Li10GeP2S12为例

note.zh: 以 Li10GeP2S12 为例，演示用神经演化势（NEP）快速训练机器学习力场，一轮主动学习即复现文献结果。
note.en: Using Li10GeP2S12 as an example, shows how to train a neuroevolution potential (NEP) quickly, reproducing literature results after one round of active learning.

items.title: 第六课：机器学习分子力场与人工智能增强的分子模拟 | MindSpore SPONGE第五季暑期学校

note.zh: 昇思 MindSpore SPONGE 暑期学校的一课，讲机器学习分子力场与人工智能增强的分子模拟。
note.en: A lesson from the MindSpore SPONGE summer school on machine-learned molecular force fields and AI-enhanced molecular simulation.

items.title: 基于深度学习的分子性质预测中不确定性估计的原理与应用 - 王鼎言博士 | 钰沐菡 公益公开课

note.zh: 讲解深度学习分子性质预测中不确定性估计的原理与应用，适合做分子性质预测建模的研究者。

items.title: Computer Aided Drug Design

items.title: Introduction to RDKit Part 1

items.title: DeepChem Introduction Tutorials

note.en: Official DeepChem introductory tutorials on loading datasets and training and evaluating molecular machine-learning models with DeepChem.

items.title: A guide to exploring drug like compounds and their biological targets using ChEMBL

items.title: AutoDock Vina Video Tutorial

items.title: OECD QSAR Toolbox

note.en: Video tutorials on the OECD QSAR Toolbox covering a wide range of its features, for both beginners and experienced users assessing chemicals with QSAR.

items.title: ML for Drug Discovery Summer School

note.zh: 药物发现机器学习暑期学校的录像，内容包括 MoML 2024 和一场黑客松，适合研究生和研究者。
note.en: Recordings from a summer school on machine learning for drug discovery, including MoML 2024 and a hackathon; for graduate students and researchers.

items.title: 2025 RDKit UGM

note.zh: 2025 年布拉格 RDKit 用户大会的报告合集，适合已经在用 RDKit 的研究者了解社区的最新工作。
note.en: Talks from the 2025 RDKit User Group Meeting in Prague, for researchers already using RDKit who want to follow recent work in the community.

items.title: 2021计算机辅助药物设计课程

note.zh: 沈阳药科大学本科药物化学课的录屏，讲数据库与可视化软件、Discovery Studio 基础操作和基于受体的药效团模型。
note.en: Recorded undergraduate classes from Shenyang Pharmaceutical University covering databases, visualization software, Discovery Studio basics and receptor-based pharmacophore models.

items.title: Autodock Vina分子对接完整步骤

note.zh: 分 13 集讲 AutoDock Vina 对接全流程：安装、对接、命令行运行，以及用 PyMOL 导出复合物、查氢键和算 RMSD。
note.en: A 13-part walkthrough of AutoDock Vina docking: installation, running jobs from the command line, and using PyMOL to export complexes, check hydrogen bonds and compute RMSD.

items.title: 化学信息学是什么？| 化学信息学（一）课程试讲 【化学+机器学习】

note.zh: 化学信息学课程的试讲第一课，讨论化学与信息学如何联系起来，以及这门学科思考哪些问题。
note.en: A trial first lecture of a cheminformatics course, discussing how chemistry and informatics connect and what questions the field asks.

items.title: RDKit系列教程：2-1 读分子操作

note.zh: RDKit 中文系列教程中讲读取分子的一节，附 Daylight SMILES 文档和 SMARTS 速查表等参考资料。
note.en: An episode of a Chinese RDKit tutorial series on reading molecules, with references such as the Daylight SMILES documentation and a SMARTS cheat sheet.

items.title: 虚拟筛选 - 到底想筛什么? 虚拟筛选目的&方法&流程&化合物挑选

note.zh: 说明为什么要做虚拟筛选、有哪些常用方法、基本流程怎样，以及最后如何挑选化合物，适合刚接触药物筛选的学生。
note.en: Explains why virtual screening is done, the main methods, the typical workflow and how compounds are finally picked; for students new to drug screening.

items.title: Computational Protein Structure Prediction and Design (JHU)
items.channel: Prof. Jeffrey J. Gray at Johns Hopkins University

note.zh: 高年级本科与研究生课程的录像，讲蛋白质结构预测与设计的计算方法；课程配有基于 PyRosetta 教程的上机环节。
note.en: Recorded lectures from an advanced undergraduate and graduate course on computational protein structure prediction and design; the course included a workshop based on the PyRosetta tutorials.

items.title: Machine Learning Methods for Protein Modeling and Design - A Rosetta Bootcamp

note.zh: 训练营录像，系统讲授基于机器学习的生物大分子结构预测与蛋白质设计方法。
note.en: Bootcamp recordings teaching machine-learning methods for biomolecular structure prediction and protein design.

items.title: How to interpret AlphaFold structures

note.zh: 介绍 AlphaFold 系统，以及它预测出的蛋白质结构该如何解读和使用。
note.en: Webinar introducing the AlphaFold system and how to interpret and use the protein structures it predicts.

items.title: ColabFold - Making protein folding accessible to all via Google Colab!
items.channel: Boston Protein Design and Modeling Club

note.zh: 讲解 ColabFold 怎样借助 Google Colab，让普通研究者也能运行 AlphaFold 类蛋白质结构预测。
note.en: Talk on how ColabFold uses Google Colab to make AlphaFold-style protein structure prediction available to any researcher.

items.title: AlphaFold Decoded - Implementing AlphaFold 2 from Scratch

note.zh: 九讲系列，从 PyTorch、机器学习和注意力机制讲起，动手完整实现 AlphaFold 2，只需会 Python。
note.en: Nine-part series building a full AlphaFold 2 implementation in PyTorch, starting from PyTorch, machine learning and attention; only Python is assumed.

items.title: Exploring PDB structures in 3D with Mol* (MolStar)

note.zh: 入门系列，教你在 RCSB 网站上用 Mol* 查看 PDB 结构，并制作结构图片和动画。
note.en: Introductory series on viewing PDB structures with the Mol* viewer on rcsb.org and making images and animations.

items.title: Getting Started in Cryo-EM

note.zh: 加州理工录制的冷冻电镜系列讲座，面向刚开始接触冷冻电镜结构解析的学生。
note.en: Caltech lecture series for newcomers to cryo-electron microscopy and its use in determining biomolecular structures.

items.title: Nazim Bouatta | Machine learning for protein structure prediction, Part 1: Algorithm space

note.zh: 机器学习与蛋白质折叠专题讲座的第一讲，梳理机器学习结构预测方法的算法空间。
note.en: First lecture of a special series on machine learning and protein folding, surveying the algorithm space of machine-learning structure prediction.

items.title: AlphaFold的原理和展望 - 钟博子韬 | 钰沐菡 公益公开课

note.zh: 公益公开课，讲 AlphaFold 的原理、正确的使用方法，以及深度学习在生命科学研究中的应用。
note.en: Free public lecture on how AlphaFold works, how to use it properly, and how deep-learning methods are applied in life-science research.

items.title: rosetta教程:00教程介绍与用法

note.zh: Rosetta 蛋白设计套件中文教程演示系列的开篇，介绍教程内容与用法，配有 Gitee 上的笔记。
note.en: Opening episode of a Chinese demo series on the Rosetta protein design suite, introducing the tutorials and how to use them, with notes on Gitee.

items.title: 利用Swiss-Model同源建模

note.zh: 用 SWISS-MODEL 网站做蛋白质同源建模，再用 PyMOL 的 align 给建模结果补上配体。
note.en: Homology modelling of a protein on the SWISS-MODEL server, then using PyMOL's align to add a ligand to the model.

items.title: AlphaFold3实操教程来咯，全新结构预测神器，还不快来跟着教学视频操练一下？

note.zh: AlphaFold 3 实操演示，预测单个蛋白、蛋白-蛋白复合物和蛋白多聚体的结构。
note.en: Hands-on demonstration of AlphaFold 3 for predicting single proteins, protein–protein complexes and multimers.

items.title: CryoEM数据处理进阶篇I Cryosparc的基本运用

note.zh: 较详细地演示 CryoSPARC 处理冷冻电镜数据的基本操作，系列后续还讲局部精修和 RELION。
note.en: Detailed walkthrough of basic cryo-EM data processing in CryoSPARC, from a Chinese series that continues with local refinement and RELION.

items.title: MolSSI Python Data and Scripting

note.zh: 面向计算化学科研新手的 Python 课程：数据类型、文件解析、函数、NumPy、Pandas、SciPy 拟合与科学绘图。
note.en: Python course for students starting computational chemistry research: data types, file parsing, functions, NumPy, Pandas, SciPy data fitting and scientific visualization.

items.title: 2021 Materials Project Workshop

note.zh: Materials Project 动手工作坊录像，从 Python 基础讲到 pymatgen、Materials API 和 MPContribs 数据共享。
note.en: Hands-on workshop recordings going from Python basics to pymatgen, the Materials API and sharing data through MPContribs.

items.title: Tutorials (Materials Science)

note.zh: 逐步演示材料研究中常用的 Python 工具，包括 pymatgen、matcalc 和 Materials Project API。
note.en: Step-by-step tutorials on Python tools for materials research, covering pymatgen, matcalc and the Materials Project API.

items.title: Atomate2 tutorial #1: Simulate Materials Properties on Your Computer

note.zh: atomate2 新手教程第一部分，讲本机安装并运行几类模拟；后续两集讲 MongoDB、高通量和 jobflow-remote。
note.en: Part 1 of an atomate2 tutorial for new users: local installation and running several simulation types; later parts cover MongoDB, high-throughput runs and jobflow-remote.

items.title: AiIDA virtual tutorial, July 2021

note.zh: 第二届 AiiDA 线上教程的报告录像，讲怎样用 AiiDA 运行和管理计算工作流，配有在线教程文档。
note.en: Presentations from the second AiiDA virtual tutorial on running and managing computational workflows with AiiDA, with accompanying online tutorial documentation.

items.title: Jakob Schiøtz: Introduction to ASE

note.zh: CAMd 暑期学校讲座，入门介绍用 Python 搭建和驱动原子模拟的工具包 ASE。
note.en: Summer-school lecture introducing ASE, the Python toolkit for setting up and driving atomistic simulations.

items.title: Materials Informatics

note.zh: 材料信息学课程，讲机器学习方法在材料研究中的应用，包括用 Materials Project API 获取数据，配套 GitHub 代码仓库。
note.en: A materials informatics course on machine-learning techniques for materials research, including data access through the Materials Project API, with an accompanying GitHub repository.

items.title: 2023 Complex Scientific Workflows at Extreme Computational Scales

note.zh: 研讨会报告录像，讨论在超算上用海量小型量子计算高通量探索材料化学空间时的复杂工作流。
note.en: Workshop talks on complex high-throughput workflows that run many small quantum calculations on large computers to explore the chemical space of materials.

items.title: Quantum chemistry calculations with python: S1 - Molecular input for DFT calculations with RDkit.

note.zh: Python 量子化学计算工作坊第一讲，演示用 RDKit 为 DFT 计算准备分子输入，代码放在 GitHub。
note.en: First session of a Python quantum-chemistry workshop, showing how to prepare molecular input for DFT calculations with RDKit; files are on GitHub.

items.title: 利用python做计算材材料入门（1）

note.zh: 入门讲解用 Python 做计算材料研究时要掌握的基础知识，后面还有第二集。
note.en: Introductory session on the Python basics needed for computational materials work; a second part follows.

items.title: pymatgen_01

note.zh: 中文 pymatgen 讲解系列的第一集；同一作者后面还有第二集，以及用 pymatgen 制作缺陷生成器的一集。
note.en: First episode of a Chinese pymatgen series; later episodes include a second part and one on building a defect generator with pymatgen.

items.title: [ChengLab]Atomic Simulation Environment ASE建模

note.zh: 课题组新生入学培训的录像，演示用 ASE 搭建原子结构模型。
note.en: Recording of a research group's onboarding training on building atomic structure models with ASE.

items.title: Materials Project网站使用简介—查找cif文件（一）

note.zh: 演示在 Materials Project 网站检索材料并下载晶体结构 cif 文件，适合刚接触材料数据库的学生。
note.en: Walkthrough of searching the Materials Project website and downloading crystal structures as CIF files, for students new to materials databases.

items.title: python数据分析神器Jupyter notebook快速入门

note.zh: Jupyter Notebook 入门：分块运行、文档内嵌、魔法函数与多格式导出，并附线性回归小实例。
note.en: Quick start to Jupyter Notebook: running code in cells, embedded documentation, magic commands and exporting, plus a small linear-regression exercise.

items.title: Quantum Computing 4 Quantum Chemistry Intro Lectures

note.zh: 短讲座讲电子结构问题、二次量子化、VQE 和量子计算中的酉变换，面向想在量子计算机上做量子化学的学生。
note.en: Short lectures on the electronic structure problem, second quantization, VQE and unitary transformations, for students who want to do quantum chemistry on quantum computers.

items.title: Introduction to Quantum Computing and Quantum Hardware

note.zh: 从量子比特、量子线路和核心量子算法讲到量子硬件，并有为 H2、LiH 构造量子比特哈密顿量的量子化学专题，适合入门。
note.en: Covers qubits, circuits, key quantum algorithms and quantum hardware, with lectures on building qubit Hamiltonians for H2 and LiH; a first course for beginners.

items.title: Qiskit Global Summer School - 2022

note.zh: 暑期学校的讲座和编程实验，从量子计算入门讲到量子模拟：为何需要它、量子化学模拟难在哪里、有哪些常用方法。
note.en: Summer-school lectures and labs that introduce quantum computing and its use for quantum simulation: why it matters, why simulating quantum chemistry is hard and which methods are used.

items.title: Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE) | PennyLane Tutorial

note.zh: 用 PennyLane 代码讲解变分量子本征求解器，并把它用到量子化学问题上，适合初学者跟着动手。
note.en: Introduces the variational quantum eigensolver with PennyLane code and applies it to a quantum chemistry problem; a hands-on starting point for beginners.

items.title: 2024 Winter School on Quantum Information Science for Chemistry

note.zh: 第四届量子信息科学冬季学校的讲座录像，这一届聚焦量子信息科学在化学中的应用。
note.en: Lectures from the fourth annual Winter School in Quantum Information Science, an edition devoted to quantum information science for chemistry.

items.title: Quantum Algorithms Pt.2 Sample-based Methods for Quantum Simulation Javier Robledo Moreno | QGSS26

note.zh: Qiskit 全球暑期学校量子算法系列的第二讲，介绍用于量子模拟的基于采样的方法。
note.en: Second quantum-algorithms lecture of the Qiskit Global Summer School, on sample-based methods for quantum simulation.

items.title: Quantum Computing for Quantum Chemistry

note.zh: 剑桥大学化学系讨论组的系列报告，聚焦量子计算在量子化学中的应用，适合跟进研究前沿的读者。
note.en: Talks from a Cambridge chemistry department discussion group on applying quantum computing to quantum chemistry, for researchers following current work.

items.title: Quantum Advantage for Computational Chemistry
items.channel: Simons Institute for the Theory of Computing

note.zh: 研讨会报告，讨论哪些量子算法有望在计算化学中带来显著的量子优势，适合研究者。
note.en: Meeting talks on which quantum algorithms show promise of a significant quantum advantage in computational chemistry, for researchers.

items.title: 本源量子-VQE系列课程

note.zh: 讲量子化学背景、氢分子哈密顿量与 VQE 算法原理，并演示 ChemiQ 的安装和使用，适合入门。
note.en: Covers the quantum chemistry background, the hydrogen-molecule Hamiltonian and how VQE works, then shows how to install and use ChemiQ; suitable for beginners.

items.title: 量子计算与量子化学基础 （Part 1）

note.zh: 面向初学者的中文报告，把量子计算和量子化学两方面的基础概念放在一起讲。
note.en: An introductory talk that brings together the basic ideas of quantum computing and quantum chemistry for newcomers to the field.

items.title: 量子计算变分量子本征值求解（VQE）算法介绍

note.zh: 长篇讲解变分量子本征求解器的原理，以最早提出 VQE 的论文为参考，适合有量子计算基础的读者。
note.en: A long talk on how the variational quantum eigensolver works, built around the paper that introduced VQE, for viewers who know basic quantum computing.

items.title: 量子计算入门与编程（四）：变分量子算法

note.zh: 量子计算入门与编程系列中的一讲，讲变分量子算法的思路与实现，适合已学过量子线路基础的读者。
note.en: One lecture of an introductory quantum computing and programming series, on the ideas behind variational quantum algorithms and how to implement them, for viewers who know basic quantum circuits.

items.title: 【完结】大一新生也能懂的量子计算

note.zh: 只需线性代数基础，从布洛赫球、密度算符和量子线路讲到 Deutsch-Jozsa、Simon 和 Grover 算法，为学量子化学算法打底。
note.en: Needs only linear algebra: the Bloch sphere, density operators and quantum circuits, then the Deutsch-Jozsa, Simon and Grover algorithms; groundwork before quantum chemistry algorithms.

items.title: Introduction to Large Language Models (LLMs)

note.zh: 从自然语言处理问题、用深度学习做语言建模讲到 Transformer 架构细节，适合想弄懂大模型原理的理工科学生。
note.en: University course from NLP problems and neural language modelling to the details of the Transformer architecture, for science students who want to understand how LLMs work.

items.title: AI Agents for Beginners

note.zh: 从概念到代码讲智能体：框架选择、设计原则、工具调用、智能体式 RAG、上下文工程与部署，适合准备自己搭化学智能体的人。
note.en: Lessons from concept to code: choosing a framework, agent design, tool use, agentic RAG, context engineering and deployment; useful before building a chemistry agent.

items.title: From ML Potentials to Agents That Write the Paper: AI for Computational Chemistry

note.zh: 完整讲座，梳理人工智能如何改变计算化学的工作方式，从机器学习势讲到自动化研究的智能体，适合计算化学研究者。
note.en: A full workshop lecture on how AI is changing computational chemistry, from machine-learning potentials to agents that automate research, for computational chemists.

items.title: AI4Chemistry Caltech Bootcamp 2026 – 13 Agentic AI

note.zh: 化学 AI 训练营中的一讲，专讲面向化学的智能体式 AI，适合已了解大模型、想把智能体用到化学研究中的学生。
note.en: A bootcamp session on agentic AI for chemistry, for students who know the basics of LLMs and want to apply agents to chemical research.

items.title: 33. Large Language Models in Materials Science

note.zh: 材料信息学课程中的一讲，介绍大语言模型给材料科学研究带来的变化，适合材料与化学方向的入门者。
note.en: A lecture from a materials informatics course on how large language models are changing materials science research, for newcomers from materials and chemistry.

items.title: MIA: Sam Cox, Automating Chemistry With LLM-Based Agents; Primer: Andrew White

note.zh: 先以导读回顾化学研究自动化的进展，再讲基于大语言模型的智能体如何自动完成化学任务，适合研究生和研究者。
note.en: A primer reviewing progress in automating chemistry, then a talk on LLM-based agents that carry out chemistry tasks, for graduate students and researchers.

items.title: Andrés M Bran | Augmenting Large Language Models with Chemistry tools | MLiS 2024

note.zh: 讲解如何把化学工具接入大语言模型，使它能执行专业化学任务，适合想了解化学智能体工作原理的研究者。
note.en: Explains how connecting chemistry tools to a large language model lets it carry out specialised chemical tasks, for researchers curious how chemistry agents work.

items.title: Gabe Gomes: Autonomous chemical research with large language models

note.zh: 研讨会报告，探讨用大语言模型自动完成反应发现和分子设计、减少人工操作，适合关注自动化实验的研究者。
note.en: Seminar on using large language models to automate reaction discovery and molecular design with less manual work, for researchers interested in autonomous experimentation.

items.title: 【专题报告】大语言模型（LLM）在化学中的应用（Large Language Model in Chemistry）

note.zh: 中文专题报告，介绍大语言模型如何理解化学语言和分子结构，并辅助性质预测、分子设计与反应规划，适合化学背景的入门者。
note.en: Overview of how large language models read chemical language and molecular structures and help with property prediction, molecular design and reaction planning, for chemists new to the area.

items.title: 上海人工智能实验室 大模型中心负责人 陈恺 深度解读 Intern-S1——科学多模态大模型

note.zh: 研发团队负责人讲解这一开源科学多模态大模型的核心技术架构与关键创新，模型重点强化了多学科科学能力。
note.en: The development team's lead explains the core architecture and key innovations of this open scientific multimodal model, which was built with a focus on multidisciplinary science.

items.title: 20251126【AI 赋能科学计算与科学发现】许岩岩：科学大模型加速有机化学合成

note.zh: 讲科学大模型怎样加速有机化学合成；报告人团队发布的化学合成大模型 Chemma 曾与化学家合作探索未报道的反应。
note.en: On how scientific foundation models can speed up organic synthesis; the speaker's team released the Chemma synthesis model and used it with chemists to explore unreported reactions.

items.title: 【AI for Chemistry】中国科学技术大学江俊教授：理实交融的机器化学家探索

note.zh: 论坛报告，介绍把理论计算和实验结合起来的机器化学家研究，适合关注 AI 化学家与自动化实验室的研究者。
note.en: Forum talk on a machine chemist that combines theory and experiment, for researchers following AI chemists and automated laboratories.

items.title: 20260528【AI for Science 2026 年度进展报告】欧阳万里、唐诗翔：从工具辅助到系统集成的自主科学发现新范式

note.zh: 年度综述报告，讲人工智能在科研中的角色如何从单点辅助工具走向能自主发现的集成系统，适合关注科学大模型的研究者。
note.en: An annual review of how AI in research is moving from single assisting tools to integrated systems for autonomous discovery, for researchers following scientific foundation models.
